name: Reproduce ordinary swim toward second Nirnroot shoreline checkpoint

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local types=require('openmw.types')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local t=-3;local path=nil;local step=2;local attempts=0
local goal=util.vector3(48425.09375,94541.5859375,19.082687377929688)
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 t=t+dt;if t<.2 then return end;t=0
 assert(not types.Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during original Nirnroot approach')
 local count=types.Actor.inventory(self):countOf(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x4e940))
 print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot stock='..count)
 if count>1 then print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot ingredient received');return end
 local finish=goal-self.position;local distance=math.sqrt(finish.x*finish.x+finish.y*finish.y)
 if distance<850 then print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot shoreline checkpoint') end
 local reached=distance<65 and (camera.getPosition()-goal):length()<160
 if reached then print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot arrived') end
 local target
 if reached then
 local plant=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6f182));assert(plant and plant:isValid(),'Original Nirnroot not present')
 target=plant:getBoundingBox().center
 elseif distance<250 then target=goal
 else target=goal
 end
 local v=target-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local yaw=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y);local pitch=-camera.getPitch()
 if reached then local p=camera.getViewTransform():apply(target);yaw=math.atan2(p.x,-p.z);pitch=-math.atan2(p.y,math.sqrt(p.x*p.x+p.z*p.z))
 local origin=camera.getPosition();local ray=nearby.castRenderingRay(origin,origin+camera.viewportToWorldVector(util.vector2(.5,.5))*2000,{{ignore=self}})
 local plant=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6f182))
 if ray.hitObject==plant and math.abs(yaw)<.02 and math.abs(pitch)<.02 then print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot plant facing') end
 end
 print(string.format('VilverinContinue Nirnroot aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(yaw*256+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor(pitch*256+.5)))))
 if math.abs(yaw)<.06 then print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot path facing') end
 print('VilverinContinue Nirnroot sample step='..step..' pos='..tostring(self.position)..' health='..types.Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' distance='..distance)
end}}}}
